dataset: eight newly authored questions over existing public synthetic corpus; developer knew previous results; not independently blind or human reviewed
train_dev: none for this release; previous v1 splits remain unchanged
test: all eight input IDs; labels kept separate until all predictions are recorded
duplicate_policy: exact normalized question check against prior v1 and P07 QA cases; thematic near-duplicates and shared documents are explicitly acknowledged
qa: local Qwen 4B Q4_K_M; current signed BFF with one real Java active profile; extractive QA, 512 output tokens, context 4096, temperature 0.2, seed 42, no retries; score after all predictions
retrieval: same E5 bundle/corpus/config, top5, lexical/dense/hybrid; document+section relevance; no reranker; current ACL, same scope/as_of
measurements: per-case status/answer/source and ranked document/section, Recall@5 and MRR@5 for positive relevance, latency p50/p95; local provider bill zero, compute cost not measured
stopping: persist each result; no automatic retry; unavailable rows recorded; do not alter dataset/parameters after seeing predictions
qa_baseline: Empty-evidence service guard invokes no model; HTTP/auth differs; not a matched prompt-only LLM baseline
retrieval_as_of: UTC calendar date at evaluation; recorded; cases run sequentially without retries
scope: Eight newly authored questions on existing public synthetic sources; author saw prior metrics, same-topic overlap; no independent blind holdout or human labels
